subcriteria.name: Accuracy_and_Completeness
subcriteria.description: Apparent correctness, internal consistency, adequate coverage of essential points and necessary context. Without a source document this is not source-grounded verification.

subcriteria.name: Logical_Flow
subcriteria.description: Coherent ordering, narrative progression, transitions, and whether slides build upon one another.

subcriteria.name: Cognitive_Rhythm
subcriteria.description: Deliberate variation between dense/new-information slides and lighter recovery or summary slides, avoiding constant overload or constant shallowness.

criteria.name: Visual_Design
criteria.description: Evaluate aesthetic quality, visual consistency, and professional appearance.

subcriteria.name: Color_Scheme
subcriteria.description: Harmony, contrast, palette balance, and unified color application.

subcriteria.name: Typography
subcriteria.description: Font readability, consistency, sizing, and hierarchy.

subcriteria.name: Visual_Consistency
subcriteria.description: Cross-slide consistency of color, motifs, style, and visual identity.

subcriteria.name: Image_Quality
subcriteria.description: Resolution, relevance, cropping, distortion, and stylistic integration of imagery.

subcriteria.name: Theme_Appropriateness
subcriteria.description: How well the visual theme matches the topic and intended audience.

criteria.name: Layout
criteria.description: Evaluate spatial organization, balance, alignment, and readability.

subcriteria.name: Spatial_Balance
subcriteria.description: Effective whitespace, information density, balance, and visual weight.

subcriteria.name: Element_Alignment
subcriteria.description: Alignment, spacing, grids, margins, and positional precision.

subcriteria.name: No_Overlapping
subcriteria.description: Absence of unintended collisions, clipping, occlusion, and overflow.

criteria.name: Complexity
criteria.description: Evaluate visual richness and design sophistication without rewarding clutter.

subcriteria.name: Charts_and_Data
subcriteria.description: Presence, quality, and sophistication of charts, tables, diagrams, and data communication.

subcriteria.name: Visual_Elements
subcriteria.description: Variety, relevance, and integration of images, icons, illustrations, and graphics.

subcriteria.name: Advanced_Design
subcriteria.description: Use of depth, layering, custom graphics, visual effects, and sophisticated techniques.

subcriteria.name: Layout_Variety
subcriteria.description: Meaningful variation of layouts across slides while retaining consistency.
